lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments; spacing is relatively wider at the shoulder and becomes increasingly compact toward the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A bifurcation is visible on the 6th line segment from the anterior, located at the mid-lateral coordinate of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: Line segments 7 through 11 terminate before reaching the ventral boundary of the torso; segments 10 and 11 are reduced to elongated dash-like markings.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 12 high-contrast spots is visible on the posterior haunch, with high density concentrated on the lateral aspect of the upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A horizontal alignment of three distinct spots is visible across the mid-haunch region, parallel to the ground plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white chevron on the bridge of the nose and white distal leg markings above the hooves.
